title: bristol-companies.com — claimed by settra
description: US · Other · Bristol Industries LLC, a U.S. Department of Defense contractor managing FUDS (Formerly Used Defense Sites) program data, has systematically violated cybersecurity requirements for 6 years. The company has access to Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), coordinates of thousands of military sites, and chemical weapons burial data, but fails to provide adequate protection for this information.
